title: CWSSU Recruitment 2026 – Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Posts
shortInfo: CWSSU has announced notification for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor posts. Required qualification: Master's, Ph.D., NET. Last date to apply: 11-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/cwssu.
Create and complete your profile on the recruitment portal by furnishing details of educational qualification, work experience, publications, and other relevant information.
Apply for the desired post online between 22nd September 2026 and 11th October 2026 (midnight).
Pay the application fee exclusively through the recruitment portal.
No application submitted through email, post, courier, or any other mode shall be accepted.
Candidates already in service must apply through the online portal and produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.

title: Meghalaya Home Guards Recruitment 2026 – Home Guards Posts
shortInfo: Meghalaya Home Guards has announced notification for Home Guards posts. Required qualification: Other. Last date to apply: 28-09-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

howToApply: Obtain the Prescribed Standard Form for application.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the Standard Form and attach a second copy.

Attach attested/self-attested copies of: Educational Qualification Certificate, Birth/Age Certificate, EPIC card of Meghalaya, Home Guards Basic Training Certificate, and Medical Fitness Certificate from an Authorized Government Medical Practitioner/Institution.
Submit the completed application to the respective District Home Guards Offices / Officers Commanding District Training Centre / Civil Defence Offices from where the volunteer is being deployed.
Applications must be received on or before 28th September 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.
